what: 2024 (Hugging Face) vs live Sept 2026 (divar-mcp) asking prices, like-for-like slice
slice: Mashhad apartment-rent, 2 bedrooms, 70-130 m2; median full-deposit equivalent = deposit + rent/0.03 (Toman)
method_2026: divar-mcp search_ads (limit 30, pages 3) with query=<neighborhood>, cards kept only if their district matches; shared rooms and placeholder prices dropped. Only these aggregates were kept.
why: median of the neighborhood ratios with n_2026 >= 20 (1.94, 2.14, 2.31, 2.68 -> 2.22); city-wide 2.44 is 27 newest ads only. National SCI rent inflation (~32-35%/yr, unverified) compounds to ~1.8-1.9 over 2.2 years.
caveats: 2026 samples are small (20-25 ads per neighborhood); vakilabad (2 ads) and hashemieh (0) had too few matches; one global factor keeps the 2024 relative prices between neighborhoods.
